title: Powering next-generation precision therapeutics through integrated synthetic transcriptional systems.
authors: Zhong, Bei; Zhou, Li; Li, Rongqi; Wang, Hui; Li, Wei; Teng, Fei
one_liner_zh: 综述了合成启动子与合成转录因子整合系统在精准治疗中的应用，涉及AI辅助设计，但未聚焦TF-DNA结合机制建模，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移的中档文献。
abstract: Mammalian synthetic biology holds great promise for treating complex diseases but faces challenges such as functional leakage and imprecise control dynamics. The advent of synthetic promoters (synPs) and transcription factors (synTFs) has expanded the genetic toolkit, and their coordinated integration enables precise, intelligent, and multidimensional regulation. Advances in promoter engineering and modular synTF design, aided by artificial intelligence, have shifted the field from empirical, trial-and-error discovery to rational, predictive design. This progress has facilitated the construction of synthetic circuits that integrate multiple endogenous and exogenous inputs through logic gates, feedback loops, and tunable systems. Such innovations support dynamic, spatiotemporally precise control, enhancing therapeutic precision and reducing off-target effects. By addressing key translational requirements, including multi-input sensing, tunable expression, and high orthogonality, integrated synP-synTF systems are advancing sophisticated mammalian therapeutics. This review summarizes progress in engineered and integrated systems, highlighting dynamic regulatory strategies and their therapeutic applications.
abstract_zh: 哺乳动物合成生物学在治疗复杂疾病方面展现出巨大潜力，但面临功能泄漏和控制动力学不精确等挑战。合成启动子（synPs）和转录因子（synTFs）的出现扩展了遗传工具库，其协调整合实现了精确、智能和多维度的调控。在人工智能辅助下，启动子工程和模块化synTF设计的进展，使该领域从经验性、试错式发现转向理性、预测性设计。这一进步促进了合成电路的构建，这些电路通过逻辑门、反馈回路和可调系统整合多种内源和外源输入。此类创新支持动态、时空精确的控制，增强了治疗精确性并减少了脱靶效应。通过解决关键转化需求，包括多输入感知、可调表达和高正交性，整合的synP-synTF系统正推动复杂哺乳动物疗法的进步。本综述总结了工程化和整合系统的进展，重点介绍了动态调控策略及其治疗应用。
